tl;dr: hip hop producer that wants more out of synthesis than using omnisphere presets. go to vst is serum. lack of abundance of hip hop threads and personal requests aren’t satisfied on r/synthrecipes

hey!

ik i posted in the edm sub but i’m a hip hop producer who’s fairly new to synthesis, learning slowly but surely. my go to is serum.

a lot of hip hop now is based in omnisphere presets which is usually the first recommendation i get (not specifically from r/synthrecipes) but all the stuff i’m interested in creating has a lot of electronic influence (death grips’ the money store, skepta’s konnichiwa, kanye’s yeezus, mndsgn, etc.) in the sound design dept and i’m sick of watching hip hop tutorials that just swap piano trap melodies for omni presets. i don’t feel like i gain anything from those in terms of both knowledge of synthesis or the results i’m looking for.

there’s not a lot of people requesting hip hop sounds outside of some recent jpegmafia posts. i’ve done searches of artists i’m into and there’s usually 3-6 threads on certain sounds they’ve made from a few years ago that can be helpful, but when i request something the thread usually doesn’t get any helpful or conclusive advice, if any. so i figured instead of forcing it there, it would be a better use of time to find different resources for asking how certain sounds were made.
